description: Acknowledge an ongoing incident, signalling that someone is looking into it (stops further escalation). Idempotent-ish: acknowledging an already-acknowledged incident returns HTTP 409. Uptime API: POST /api/v3/incidents/{id}/acknowledge.

acknowledged_by.description: User e-mail or a custom identifier of who is acknowledging the incident.

incident_id.description: The incident id to acknowledge (from list_incidents).

name: acknowledge_incident
title: Acknowledge an incident
